url.title: Target URL
url.description: The URL you want to scrape

parsed_data.title: Return parsed data
parsed_data.description: If enabled, returns structured JSON data extracted from the page (via Schema.org / __NEXT_DATA__ / AI rules) instead of the raw HTML.

markdown.title: Return Markdown (for LLMs)
markdown.description: If enabled, returns the page as clean Markdown instead of HTML: headings, lists, tables, absolute links, images with alt text and code blocks, without scripts, styles, navigation, footers or forms. Built for LLMs, AI agents and RAG, and charged like an HTML result. Cannot be combined with parsed data or list elements.

main_content_only.title: Markdown: main content only
main_content_only.description: Used with Markdown: keep only the page's main content and drop navigation, the site header, footer and sidebars. Turn off to convert the whole page.

list_elements.title: List interactive elements
list_elements.description: Return the page's interactive elements (buttons, inputs, selects, links, forms) with ready-to-use selectors instead of HTML - useful to discover what to target before building Browser steps.

steps.title: Browser steps
steps.description: An ordered list of browser actions to run after the page loads: wait_for, wait_for_text, wait, click, type, select, press_key, scroll. Example: [{"action":"type","selector":"#q","value":"bmw"},{"action":"press_key","value":"Enter"},{"action":"wait_for","selector":".results"}]. Runs once (non-idempotent); a failed step returns which step failed plus the page HTML.

proxy_country.title: Proxy country
proxy_country.description: Route the request through an exit proxy in a specific country. Leave as Random to let ScrapeUnblocker pick the best country for the target.
